description: Retrieve Script Activity metadata for one exact credential/BU/script key using reviewed Windows mcdev 10.1.0; never execute SSJS or run an automation. Performs fresh local preparation; no preview token or custom approval form is required. Host tool approval remains host-controlled. Caller must maintain quiescent project/path access through preparation and settlement; external exclusion is not enforced. Native paginated collection reads can include unrelated remote scripts before local key filtering. Native mcdev may create/overwrite or delete JSON and SSJS/HTML candidates, read parent/shared dependencies and privately refresh/persist authentication/session state. Local materialization requires changed JSON plus exactly one SSJS or HTML companion; both companions are ambiguous. No authentication/session content inspection or raw native output is returned. Request cancellation is supervised; partial effects and unknown termination are possible. Unknown termination blocks both retrieval families for that project pending operator reconciliation; restarting is not reconciliation. No automatic retry. Zero exit and local artifacts never prove remote completeness.
name: retrieve_mcdev_script
